findings.problem: canFlagRow's empty-slot branch repeats `loadedCheckId != null`, which canFlag already encodes. This is correct (the empty-slot arm needs its own check-loaded guard) but could be mistaken for redundancy and 'simplified' away.
findings.fix: Keep the `loadedCheckId != null` conjunct in the empty-slot branch: `canFlag || (!!user && loadedCheckId != null && isEmptySlotStatus(status))`. Do not remove it.

findings.problem: The broadened hint shows 'right-click a missed/extra instance to flag it' to any logged-in non-allocated viewer even when the loaded check has no missed/extra rows.
findings.fix: Optional: gate the phrase on `videoRows.some(r => r.status === 'missed' || r.status === 'extra')`. Permission logic is unaffected either way.

findings.location: Design: Wiring point 2 — openFlagMenu internal guard (~line 1320)
findings.problem: Confirmation only: the admin-resolve path on an already-flagged fully-populated row relies on allowResolve staying true while allowFlag (canFlagRow) is false.
findings.fix: No change. Verified the new guard keeps `allowResolve = canResolveDispute && isFlagged` so admins keep resolve access on full rows.
